reason: Adds a hold-to-talk microphone button to the DeepSeek Harness Web composer, performs offline local speech recognition, and appends the result to the draft without automatic submission.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框添加按住说话麦克风按钮，并在本机离线识别后将文字追加到草稿中。
summaries.en: Adds a hold-to-talk microphone button to the DeepSeek Harness Web composer and appends locally transcribed speech to the draft without sending it.

capabilities: Captures microphone audio after user interaction
Transcribes recorded speech locally with an offline ASR engine
Runs a localhost HTTP service for audio transcription
Downloads and stores an approximately 229 MB speech-recognition model
Appends transcription text to the current chat draft without sending it
